mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS depressant effects; tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, with potential for additive anticholinergic adverse effects.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (constipation, urinary retention, cognitive impairment) and CNS depression; consider dose adjustment of tolterodine if adverse effects occur.
